# FG-CI-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_expired_lease_is_returned_to_the_queue_exactly_once` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この CI のジョブの割り当ては失われました。ジョブは待ちの列に戻されています。
- en: This CI job's lease was lost. The job has been returned to the queue.
- id: Sewa tugas CI ini hilang. Tugas telah dikembalikan ke antrean.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C3 (plan 14, ADR-0029): a runner holds a job only while its lease lasts (`ci_jobs.lease_until`, extended by each heartbeat; compared with the database's `now()`). The lease ran out — the runner stopped sending heartbeats (crashed, lost its network, the host was overloaded) or sent one too late — and either the runner asked to extend, append a log to or complete the job after that (the runner API answers 409 with this code; the runner must stop the job), or the lease reaper (`forge worker`, `ci.lease_reaper`) took the job back: it returns the job to the queue (`pending`, a new attempt) exactly once and revokes its job token in the same transaction, or fails it with this code after the third lost lease (`lease_losses` reached the limit). Not a fault of the job's script.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The reaper logs `forge.ci.job_lease_lost` (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `job_id`, `pipeline_id`, `project_id`, `runner_id`, `lease_losses` and `outcome` (`requeued` / `failed`); the runner API logs the refused call with `job_id`, `runner_id` and `operation` (`heartbeat` / `log` / `complete`). Read the job: SELECT id, status, runner_id, lease_until, lease_losses, attempt, error_code FROM forge.ci_jobs WHERE id = <job_id>; and the runner: SELECT id, name, enabled, last_contact_at FROM forge.ci_runners WHERE id = <runner_id>; a runner whose `last_contact_at` is old has stopped (see runbook ci-runner).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner: restart or repair the runner host named by `runner_id`. A requeued job runs again by itself on any runner; a job failed with this code is retried by hand (gstn pipeline retry --project <id> <pipeline_id>) once a runner is healthy.
